sloka: तत्र तत्र च विन्यस्तैः सुश्लिष्टैः शयन आसनैः ।पान भूमिर् विना वह्निम् प्रदीप्ता इव उपलक्ष्यते ॥५-११-१८॥
transliteration: tatra tatra ca vinyastaiḥ suśliṣṭaiḥ śayana āsanaiḥ ।pāna bhūmir vinā vahnim pradīptā iva upalakṣyate ॥5-11-18॥

translations.english: Good couches and different kinds of seats were wellarranged in the banquet hall. The place appeared as if it was glowing witout fire.
